assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The documented symptoms and clinical findings directly support medical necessity for the service.
The service contradicts the PR-204 determination that the service is not covered.
